tests.name: Unknown IDs, invalid targets, wrong versions and unknown routes fail closed without substitution
Removed or inconsistent saved hierarchy never silently widens the view to all branches
Out-of-scope details suppress copilot and contextual attachments as well as the primary view
New actions retain explicit accountable scope and agree across Work and reporting
Indicator creation uses scoped risks, historical readings cannot replace current values, breach work remains visible
Missing and malformed evidence dates remain unknown; CSV preserves numbers and neutralizes formula text; timestamps use WAT
Single-file answer rejects batches and real attachment upload returns to the originating assessment
Grid evidence resolves the originating response definition instead of whichever form is currently open
Changing the actor during asynchronous upload blocks commit and keeps the batch recoverable
Approval rechecks acting identity after asynchronous file verification and creates no misleading receipt
Review drill-downs open canonical source workflows and final sign-off is included in review classification
Copilot reads canonical scoped measures, cites navigable records and clears prior answers on scope changes
Copilot tasks use form, program, risk, engagement, privacy, monthly-return and library-specific context
Restricted originals are excluded; unsupported requests and approval/signing instructions cause no mutations
Copilot proposals require explicit review, create one scoped work item, preserve domain decisions and reject stale context
Published-report copilot uses the captured snapshot rather than later live risk changes
Untrusted record text is escaped and never interpreted as copilot instructions
Open copilot fits twelve real record contexts at four widths; keyboard dismissal restores focus; dark theme works
No external model, data or asset requests during the tested local workflows
